title: Item frame Z-fighting
description: Removes item frame and pressure plate z fighting when using shaders
body:
Makes item and glow item frames slightly shorter stopping z fighting with pressure plates when using shaders.

![After image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/kXZcBtbU/images/f06bc4e4f95836a50faa7364e596ddaedb79b7c3.png)
